description: This file defines an abstract class `ModelFormAction` and several nested classes related to form actions within the OFBiz framework. It manages loading sub-actions from XML elements, executing service calls, and handling parent form actions, all within a widget/model context.

classes.name: ModelFormAction
classes.description: Abstract class representing a form action that can be part of a widget form. Provides methods to read sub-actions from XML and contains nested classes for specific actions.

classes.name: ModelFormAction.CallParentActions
classes.description: Represents the <call-parent-actions> element, facilitating the invocation of actions defined in parent forms.

classes.name: ModelFormAction.Service
classes.description: Represents the <service> element, encapsulating logic to invoke a service call within a form action.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads and constructs a list of sub-actions from an XML parent element within a form, based on child element tags.
